tok 1.0 "Work Accident"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane employee "Employee"
    start accident "Work accident or near accident occurred"
    task inform "Inform the employer"
  lane employer "Employer"
    task record "Record the accident"
    xor serious "Fatality or serious injury not reported to emergency services?"
    task labour "Report the accident to the Labour Inspectorate"
    xor unable "Insured person killed or unable to work for three days?"
    task insurer "Report the accident to the accident insurance provider within five days"
    end reported "Accident reported"
    end closed "Accident recorded"

flow accident -> inform -> record -> serious
flow serious -> labour "yes"
flow serious -> unable "no" default
flow labour -> unable
flow unable -> insurer "yes"
flow unable -> closed "no" default
flow insurer -> reported
